Definition: from G2232; to act as ruler:--be governor.
BiblicalUsage: Hegemoneuo means to be governor, to rule as governor, and Luke uses it to date the gospel itself. In Luke 2:2 Cyrenius is governor of Syria when the census is taken, and in Luke 3:1 Tiberius Caesar is in the fifteenth year of his reign when John begins to preach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Luke dates the story on purpose: the gospel did not happen in a timeless somewhere, it happened under named rulers in named years.
